name: Call of Fire
summary: Call of Fire is an introductory spiritual summons directing promising Alliance shaman novices toward deeper elemental communion. Sent by Farseer Javad or Sulaa, initiates are instructed to report to Tuluun to begin understanding and harnessing the volatile element of flame.

sections.title: A Calling to the Flame
sections.body: Once an initiate has proven their aptitude with the foundational elements, their mentor directs them onward. Fire is not an element to be approached lightly; its nature is unbridled, destructive, and fiercely independent. To take the next step in shamanic discipline, novices are sent across the wilderness to seek specialized tutelage under elder practitioners who know how to commune with the blazing spirits without being consumed.

sections.title: The Guidance of Tuluun
sections.body: The path of fire requires guidance from seasoned hands. The novice is dispatched to seek out Tuluun at Azure Watch. Tasked with preparing the initiate for the difficult spiritual trial ahead, Tuluun serves as the bridge between theoretical rites and the demanding realities of communing with flame spirits.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Call of Fire?
faq.answer: This summons represents a rite of passage for apprentice shaman. It directs the student to leave their initial training grounds and seek out an instructor capable of guiding them through the trials necessary to commune with the spirits of flame.

faq.q: Who sends the initiate on this path?
aliases: where to start call of fire
faq.answer: Farseer Javad or Sulaa recognizes when a novice has advanced far enough in their understanding of spiritual balance to undertake the difficult trial of fire, commanding them to report for advanced instruction.

Tuluun is an experienced shaman stationed at Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle. He oversees the next stage of the novice's training, preparing them for the arduous and dangerous spiritual rituals required to earn the favor of the flame spirits.

faq.q: Why is fire considered a difficult element for a shaman?
faq.answer: Unlike the stability of earth or the fluidity of water, fire is wild, consuming, and volatile. Communing with flame requires supreme focus, strength of will, and reverence to avoid destruction.

faq.q: Where does this summons lead next?
aliases: what happens after call of fire
faq.answer: Reporting to Tuluun marks the beginning of the full trial of fire. Once you arrive at Azure Watch, Tuluun outlines the rigorous tasks and spiritual tests required to truly master the flame.

faq.q: Is this quest restricted to a specific path?
aliases: who can take call of fire
faq.answer: Yes. This journey is purely intended for shaman initiates learning to commune with elemental forces and earn their totemic bonds.

angles.text: Every shaman must earn the respect of the elements one by one; Call of Fire marks the threshold where raw power and destructive fury must be understood rather than feared.
As the spiritual arts take root within the Alliance, mentors direct apprentices toward Azure Watch to ensure their communion with the elements remains guided and disciplined.
